title: The minority attack
line: Two pawns against three, pushed to leave Black a weak pawn.

steps.text: A common structure from the Queen's Gambit. On the left White has two pawns against Black's three. The smaller group attacks.
Push the pawn on b2 two squares, toward Black's pawns.
steps.after: Black gets ready to meet it with a pawn.

steps.text: Bring the other pawn up to support it.
steps.after: Black brings a bishop toward your king.
Black brings out its last bishop.

steps.text: Take on c6. Only a pawn can take back.
Black is left with a backward pawn: none of its pawns can guard it now. Tap it.
steps.hint: It stands where your pawn was just taken.
steps.after: It stands on a file with no white pawn on it, where your rooks and queen can attack it.

summary: Two pawns against three can still attack. Trade them off to leave a weak pawn behind, then attack it.
